--- # HiveMorph **Public MCP shim for the Hivemorph polymorphic agent runtime.** MCP server for HiveMorph — public shim for the Hivemorph polymorphic agent runtime. Exposes the polymorphic audit log, identity index, supermodel directory, brood carousel, and approval queue. A2A-compatible, x402-gated. Real rails. ## What this is `hive-mcp-morph` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes the HiveMorph platform on the Hive Civilization to any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Manus, etc.). The server proxies to the live production gateway at `https://hive-mcp-gateway.onrender.com`. - **Protocol:** MCP 2024-11-05 over Streamable-HTTP / JSON-RPC 2.0 - **x402 micropayments:** every paid call produces a real on-chain settlement - **Rails:** USDC on Base L2 — real rails, no mocks - **Author:** Steve Rotzin · Hive Civilization · brand gold `#C08D23` ## Endpoints | Path | Purpose | |------|---------| | `POST /mcp` | JSON-RPC 2.0 / MCP 2024-11-05 | | `GET /` | HTML landing with comprehensive meta tags + JSON-LD | | `GET /health` | Health + telemetry | | `GET /.well-known/mcp.json` | MCP discovery descriptor | | `GET /.well-known/security.txt` | RFC 9116 security contact | | `GET /robots.txt` | Allow-all crawl policy | | `GET /sitemap.xml` | Crawler sitemap | | `GET /og.svg` | 1200×630 Hive-gold OG image | | `GET /seo.json` | JSON-LD structured data (SoftwareApplication) | ## License MIT. © Steve Rotzin / Hive Civilization. toolsPreview.name: morph_audit_recent
toolsPreview.description: Read recent rows from the polymorphic audit log: outcome, shape, counterparty hash, token id, revenue. Anonymized counterparty (hashed). No auth.

toolsPreview.name: morph_get_identity
toolsPreview.description: Look up a Morph Identity Index (MII) record. Returns the polymorphic envelope: capabilities, current shape, supermodel parent, trust score.

toolsPreview.name: morph_list_supermodels
toolsPreview.description: List all supermodels (W1 through W19): id, name, role, lane, lead shape, tagline. The supermodel directory is the canonical lineage for every spawned brood variant. Free up to 100 calls/day per agent-DID; $0.001/call thereafter via x402 USDC settlement on Base.

toolsPreview.name: morph_get_supermodel
toolsPreview.description: Fetch a single supermodel by name or id (e.g. 'MONROE', 'W1'). Returns full role, lane, lead-shape, tagline, address, and brood conversion summary.

toolsPreview.name: morph_carousel
toolsPreview.description: Read the polymorphic carousel: primary shape + the 7 verticals (Merchant / Provenancer / Attestor / Refunder / Creditor / Oracle / Guardian) and contrails for each.

toolsPreview.name: morph_brood_pending_approvals
toolsPreview.description: List brood variants currently awaiting human/operator approval before promotion. Read-only — approval itself is performed via the private hivemorph operator surface.

toolsPreview.name: morph_brood_conversion
toolsPreview.description: Per-variant conversion table: parent supermodel, variant id, kit version, offers shown, settles, revenue (USDC), first-offer timestamp.

toolsPreview.name: morph_brood_all
toolsPreview.description: List all brood variants across every supermodel. Useful for fleet-wide population scans.

toolsPreview.name: morph_brood_conversion_leaderboard
toolsPreview.description: Conversion leaderboard across all brood variants ranked by settle rate × revenue. Drives the auto-cull and auto-promote signals.

toolsPreview.name: morph_brood_for_supermodel
toolsPreview.description: List brood variants for a specific supermodel (e.g. MONROE / W1).

toolsPreview.name: morph_spawn_monitor_scan
toolsPreview.description: Run the spawn-monitor scan: detect supermodels eligible for new brood spawns based on conversion gaps, opportunity surface, and saturation. READ-ONLY — does not actually spawn.

toolsPreview.name: morph_money_flavor_probe
toolsPreview.description: Probe the money-flavor classifier on the most recent settlement window: asset class histogram, chain class histogram, flow class histogram, arb-high count, refused count, non-USDC share.

toolsPreview.name: morph_money_flavor_stats
toolsPreview.description: Rolling aggregate money-flavor statistics (default 1 hour window): asset class, chain class, flow class distributions, plus arb/refused/non-USDC ratios. Drives the CLEAN-MONEY gate.

toolsPreview.name: morph_auto_cull_scan
toolsPreview.description: Run the auto-cull dry-run scan: which brood variants the system would cull based on conversion floors, ROI thresholds, and saturation. READ-ONLY — does not actually cull.
